name: Valentine@Bitter Plus
original_name: バレンタイン＠ビタープラス
source:
[i]Will you manage to give chocolate to your beloved senpai?[/i]

Valentine's Day is tomorrow!
 
"You can do it, Yuki! I believe in you!"
 
O-okay...! My older brother is cheering me on!
I have to muster up the courage and confess my feelings!

[Translated from [url=https://kzplus55.wixsite.com/shikabanedoll/blank-5]official website[/url]]
translation:
[i]你能把巧克力送给心爱的学长吗？[/i]

明天就是情人节了！
 
“你能行的，Yuki！我相信你！”
 
哦、好吧……！哥哥在为我加油！
我必须鼓起勇气，表白我的感情！

[翻译自[url=https://kzplus55.wixsite.com/shikabanedoll/blank-5]官网[/url]]
